## Cinemantic

### [cinemantic](https://cinemantic.aliarby.com)

Cinemantic is a semantic search interface for exploring a large archive of movie frames. Instead of navigating by title, timestamp, or hand-written tags, it lets a user search visually: composition, objects, scenes, lighting, mood, and other concepts that are hard to capture with traditional metadata.

The project exists to make visual archives feel directly searchable. A frame collection becomes more useful when it can be queried by meaning, not only by filenames or database fields. Cinemantic uses embedding-based retrieval to surface visually and semantically related frames, making it easier to discover patterns across films and move through media collections by intent.

Technically, it is a media discovery system built around image embeddings, vector search, and a lightweight web interface for browsing results. It is a public project for experimenting with how retrieval models change the experience of working with dense visual data.
